### ♪ Step away, and the lyrics appear

**Which file do I download?**

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | `IdleVerse-Setup-*.exe` |
| Mac with M1 / M2 / M3 / M4 | `IdleVerse-*-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| Intel Mac | `IdleVerse-*-mac-x64.dmg` |

**First launch**
- **Windows:** if you see "Windows protected your PC", click **More info → Run anyway**.
- **Mac:** right-click IdleVerse in Applications → **Open** → **Open**. If it says the app "is damaged", run `xattr -cr /Applications/IdleVerse.app` in Terminal once.

Then play something in Spotify or Apple Music and click the ♪ icon in your tray / menu bar.
Full guide: [README](https://github.com/janakrathi/IdleVerse#-install) · [Code signing policy](https://github.com/janakrathi/IdleVerse#-code-signing-policy) · [Privacy policy](https://github.com/janakrathi/IdleVerse/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)
